epitaph: 4 Winds Wrestling ran one full awards season, gathering nominations by e-mail through November 2004 and putting the top two in each category on a hosted ballot. Its own Wrestler of the Year for 2004 was Darek DeAngelo.

epitaph: 4 Winds Wrestling never staged a Hall of Fame induction in the surviving record. What survives is the ballot: six names put to a members' vote at the end of 2004, each with the one line the fed itself thought worth printing beside it. The first of them is Jay Phoenix, billed "First Ever NWT Champion".
